method: Original 10-minute station T observations. Accepted QUALITY 0 (good) or 5 (unknown/unverified operational quality). Explicit estimates (3), suspect (1), poor (2), missing (4), non-numeric values excluded. No interpolation, model, altitude correction or filled gaps. Other variables must match T timestamp.
provider_publication: CHMI now files are published hourly and contain 10-minute observations. Scheduled downloads can be delayed. Observation time is authoritative.
